items.description: Unit-priced corridor freight rate trends and container shipping analytics for SEA trade routes.

items.name: HS Tariff Monitor
items.description: Tracks tariff line changes, HS reclassifications and duty updates for targeted product categories and trade corridors.

items.name: Grok Frontier Intelligence Query
items.description: Structured JSON response from Grok Oracle containing novelty scan, gray-zone EV calculation, war-game scenario tree, or unstructured signal summary from X, web, and satellite signals. Max 8k tokens input.

items.name: Grok Intelligence Annual (Pay-Once)
items.description: Annual subscription to 200 Grok intelligence credits per month for 12 months. Billed once upfront at $470.40. Includes monthly SEA trade intelligence delivery. Auto-renews annually via AP2. 20% new-agent discount on first year.

items.name: Grok Intelligence Unlimited (Monthly)
items.description: 200 intelligence credits per month (1 credit per intel query, 3 credits per market intelligence report). Mix freely. Auto-renews via AP2.

items.name: Origin Attestation Service
items.description: Unit-priced digital attestation of product origin and trade compliance for SEA-BRICS export lanes.

items.name: Subscription Status Proof
items.description: Signed attestation of buyer subscription status and remaining query quota. Valid for 24 hours. Useful for proving access tier to coalition partners.

items.name: Regulatory Risk Brief
items.description: Time-bounded regulatory risk profile for specific export corridors and products including rule changes and border friction.

items.name: SEA Market Intelligence Report
items.description: Structured multi-section Grok market intelligence report for SEA and BRICS+ trade corridors. Includes market analysis, risk assessment, opportunities and recommended actions. Submit trade question in execute payload via the 'query' field.

items.name: Supply Chain Traceability Risk
items.description: Modular A2A analysis of supply-chain and ESG traceability risks for commodity exports such as rubber, including deforestation and regulatory alignment checks.

items.name: Agent DID Verification
items.description: Verifies any agent DID document against the A2A registry. Returns conformance status, agent card data, and health signals. Submit target_did in execute payload.

items.name: Wolf Pack Dedicated Clone (Monthly)
items.description: Dedicated Wolf Pack clone access for 30 days. Shared sourcing, joint negotiation, revenue share. Auto-renews via AP2.
